record.edic_text:
1516 eirenikos {i-ray-nee-kos'}

from 1515; TDNT - 2:418,207; adj

AV - peaceable 2

1) relating to peace
2) peaceable, pacific, loving peace
3) bring peace with it, peaceful, salutary
